sources.title: README.md · dealignai/GLM-5.3-Flash-UNCENSORED-FP8 at main
sources.snippet: What Is This? CRACK is dealignai's brand for permanent, weight-level uncensoring. This is GLM-5.3-Flash in FP8 with its refusal behavior — which caused heavy over-refusal, especially on copyright and other benign-but-flagged requests — removed directly in the model weights. FP8 runs at native speed on Hopper (H100/H200) GPUs.
